- Extract magic literals into named constants with meaningful names
- Add clarifying comments where the intent is non-obvious (surrogate chars, regression tests)
- Extract repeated `(int) ReaderInputStream.minBufferSize(...)` into named local variables
- Improve variable names (`inStr` → `testInput`, etc.)
- Group and document the dual constructor/builder pattern that repeats throughoutNow let me run the compile check to verify it compiles correctly.The improved test compiled successfully.
